checks.nl_assertion: Agent should tell the user the total refund amount is $8,276.23.
checks.justification: The agent did not state the total refund amount as $8,276.23. The total refund from the two cancelled orders ($3,131.10 + $4,777.75) plus the Smart Watch return ($367.38) equals $8,276.23, but the agent only mentioned the $367.38 return amount and did not provide the combined total.
